provenance.coordinates: Positions are 1-based on the reference sequences (canonical UniProt entries, initiator methionine = 1). Protein field reference_md5 is the checksum of each reference sequence in UniProt's format; current UniProt annotations line up with the positions only where the current sequence has the same checksum.

Larsen 2016.label: Larsen 2016
Larsen 2016.licence: AAAS (Sci Signal supplementary Table S1: derived records only, the table is not redistributed)
Larsen 2016.quality: HEK293 cells, peptides fractionated at high pH and enriched with methylarginine antibodies, MaxQuant with peptide, protein and site FDR 0.01, monomethylation of R and K searched. Read from the article's Table S1 (8,900 sites, each with the leading protein, the position, the localisation probability and a 31-residue window): arginine sites at localisation probability >= 0.75. The leading protein is often an isoform or an unreviewed entry, so the site is placed from its window.

PhosphoSitePlus.label: PhosphoSitePlus (PSP)
PhosphoSitePlus.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 Unported (PhosphoSitePlus terms of 2021, inputs/licences/), compiled in Maron 2021 Table S5 (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, open-access supplement)
PhosphoSitePlus.quality: Curated database, accepted as curated. Through Maron Table S5: the sites PhosphoSitePlus listed on 22 May 2021, each with a 15-residue window and position, without the study behind it, a localisation score or a degree. A record is placed where its window names exactly one arginine in the reviewed proteome, in an entry the record names. PhosphoSitePlus curators find papers by semi-automatic literature search, record the sites each shows with the methods behind them, and an editor checks every record. Besides low-throughput primary papers and published mass-spectrometry studies it lists sites from Cell Signaling Technology's own high-throughput discovery runs. Its per-site download counts each kind of reference (LT_LIT, MS_LIT, MS_CST). Table S5 keeps none, so the release cannot tell which sites rest on a hand-curated primary paper.

Maron 2021.label: Maron 2021
Maron 2021.licence: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (open-access supplement, Tables S2 and S3), with localisation from the authors' search results (derived records only, the files are not redistributed)
Maron 2021.quality: A549 cells treated with GSK591 or MS023, sequential Rme1, Rme2a and Rme2s antibody immunoprecipitation, Byonic in Proteome Discoverer 2.4 with mono- and dimethylation of R and K searched, 1 % FDR, trypsin and GluC digests. Tables S2 and S3 give no localisation score, the authors' search results of the same immunoprecipitations do: Proteome Discoverer peptide groups with ptmRS site probabilities (a residue named only at >= 75 %), and the Byonic PSMs of the GluC and trypsin searches with their Delta Mod score. A mark of the tables is kept where the search localises a methyl group to that arginine of the same peptide (ptmRS >= 75 %, or Delta Mod > 20 in every high-confidence PSM of that peptide and set of marks above it, with the search's degree when it differs, noted), or where its peptide holds no other arginine or lysine. Marks the confident PSMs disagree on are kept as lower-confidence evidence.

Guo 2014.label: Guo 2014
Guo 2014.licence: CC BY 4.0 (supplementary Tables S2 and S3)
Guo 2014.quality: HCT116 cells, monomethylarginine (Me-R4-100, D5A12) and ADMA antibodies, SEQUEST with a 1 % PSM FDR, mono- and dimethylation of R and K searched. Read from Tables S2 (peptide-spectrum matches with their ModScore) and S3 (sites with a 13-residue window): a site is kept where a PSM matching its window localises it at ModScore > 13, the paper's threshold, the degree read from the precursor mass. The positions number RefSeq proteins, so the record is placed from its peptide.

Musiani 2019.label: Musiani 2019
Musiani 2019.licence: AAAS (Sci Signal supplementary Tables S1 and S2: derived records only, the tables are not redistributed)
Musiani 2019.quality: HeLa cells, SILAC with GSK591, SDMA then monomethylarginine antibody enrichment and the input, MaxQuant (1.6.1.0 in the PRIDE PXD009070 deposit) with a 1 % FDR, and heavy-methyl SILAC for the orthogonal validation. Read from the article's Table S1 (every site and identification, with the leading protein, position, 15-residue window and localisation probability) and Table S2 (the heavy-methyl SILAC pairs, Spreadsheet 2 naming the gene only, so its entry is the gene's reviewed entry that holds the peptide once): arginine sites at localisation probability >= 0.75, the best of the heavy and light peptides in Table S2. Where the window centres on more than one marked arginine (repeats such as the TAF15 RGG repeats), the record is placed from its window alone, and a window repeated in the protein adds no site.

Fong 2019.label: Fong 2019
Fong 2019.licence: Elsevier user licence (supplementary Table S4: derived records only, the table is not redistributed), PRIDE PXD012007 CC0
Fong 2019.quality: NB4 acute promyelocytic leukaemia cells, SDMA and monomethylarginine (and, with MS023, ADMA) antibody enrichment, MaxQuant with a 1 % FDR. Read from Table S4: arginine sites at localisation probability >= 0.75 and Andromeda score >= 25 (the paper accepted localisation >= 0.5), with the marked peptide and degree.

ProMetheusDB.label: ProMetheusDB
ProMetheusDB.quality: Methyl-proteome table mmc2 of the heavy-methyl SILAC and SILAC experiments behind ProMetheusDB (SK-OV-3, HeLa, NB4 and U2OS cells), MaxQuant with mono- and dimethylation of R and K and trimethylation of K searched: marked peptides, 15-residue window and degree (me or di) of each site, no localisation score. A record is kept where one of its peptides holds no other arginine or lysine, or holds no lysine and has every arginine dimethylated, and is placed from those peptides.

Li 2021.label: Li 2021
Li 2021.quality: HEK293 cells (SILAC) after PRMT4, PRMT5 or PRMT7 knockdown or SGC3027 treatment, monomethylarginine then ADMA or SDMA antibody enrichment, Proteome Discoverer 2.2 with FDR < 1 %, methylation of R and K searched, no localisation score given. Read from Supplementary Data 1, 3, 5 and 6, the sites whose methylation fell at least two-fold or vanished: a site is kept where its peptide holds no other arginine or lysine.

Fedoriw 2019.label: Fedoriw 2019
Fedoriw 2019.licence: Elsevier user licence (supplementary Tables S5 and S7: derived records only, the tables are not redistributed)
Fedoriw 2019.quality: DLBCL and pancreatic cancer cell lines with a type I PRMT inhibitor, monomethylarginine, ADMA and SDMA antibody enrichment, SEQUEST with a 2.5 % FDR, no localisation score given. Read from Tables S5 and S7 (gene symbol and marked peptide, the peptides whose methylation changed): a site is kept where its peptide holds one arginine, or every arginine dimethylated, and occurs once in the entries of its gene, which gives the position.

UniProt.label: UniProt
UniProt.quality: UniProt release 2026_03 annotations of methylated arginines (MOD_RES) with experimental evidence from the literature (ECO:0000269), curated residue by residue. Annotations from large-scale proteomics (ECO:0007744), which repeat the studies read here, and those by similarity are left out. Position only, placed where the residue is an arginine of the entry.

Lim 2020.label: Lim 2020
Lim 2020.quality: Pooled colorectal cancer tissue from 10 patients, monomethylarginine and ADMA antibody enrichment, SEQUEST with a 2.5 % FDR. Read from Tables S1 and S2: sites with ModScore > 13 (the paper's threshold), each with peptide, window and degree. The tables write some leucines as I: L is written back where the reported entry, or one site of the reviewed proteome, matches with I and L taken as one residue.

Wei 2020.label: Wei 2020
Wei 2020.quality: HPDE6c7 and PANC-1 cells, ADMA antibody enrichment, MaxQuant 1.6.0.16 with FDR < 0.01, Andromeda score > 40 and localisation probability > 0.75. Read from Table 1: the 289 sites with peptide and 31-residue window, 137 of them numbered on an isoform, placed from the peptide.

IEDB.label: IEDB
IEDB.licence: IEDB query API, terms at www.iedb.org/terms_of_use_v3.php (epitopes the iPTMnet-format master table cites)
IEDB.quality: Immune Epitope Database epitopes (HLA-presented peptides) with a methylated arginine, the 85 the iPTMnet-format master table cites, read from the IEDB query API: a site is kept where the epitope holds no other arginine or lysine. The degree is not given.

Hartel 2019.label: Hartel 2019
Hartel 2019.licence: CC BY 4.0 (the article and its supplement, from 2020-09-15, and PRIDE PXD012357, CC0), records staged from supplementary Tables S1-S15
Hartel 2019.quality: Peptide-spectrum matches and peptide groups (Proteome Discoverer) with the methylated arginine marked, Percolator q <= 0.01 and ptmRS localisation >= 75 %. LN229 Tables S1-S2 give no positions: their rows take the position Tables S3-S15 give for the same protein, peptide and residue, and are dropped without one.

Geoghegan 2015.label: Geoghegan 2015
Geoghegan 2015.licence: CC BY 4.0 (the article and its Supplementary Table 1)
Geoghegan 2015.quality: Heavy-methyl SILAC peptide pairs with the methylated arginine marked, q <= 0.05 (0.93 % FDR for the paired set), localised at ModLS > 8 or unambiguously (rows at ModLS 8 or below are kept as lower-confidence evidence). Positions number the first accession of the protein group, often an unreviewed entry, so the site is placed from the peptide.

Sylvestersen 2014.label: Sylvestersen 2014
Sylvestersen 2014.licence: CC BY 4.0 (the article and its supplement, from 2020-10-12, and PRIDE PXD000559, CC0)
Sylvestersen 2014.quality: MaxQuant site tables with a 13-residue window and the peptide, localisation probability >= 0.75. The export writes every leucine as isoleucine: L is written back where the reported entry, or else one site of the reviewed proteome, matches with I and L taken as one.

Lu 2025.label: Lu 2025
Lu 2025.licence: CC BY 4.0 (the article and Dataset EV1)
Lu 2025.quality: The 743 dimethylarginine sites of Dataset EV1 come without peptides or localisation scores (SEQUEST HT, Percolator 1 % FDR). A site is kept only where a PSM localises it by mass, every arginine of its peptide dimethylated (155 sites), and the other 588 are kept as lower-confidence evidence.

Ma 2023.label: Ma 2023
Ma 2023.licence: CC0 (PRIDE PXD038203 Table S1), the article is not open access
Ma 2023.quality: MaxQuant ADMA-antibody sites with a 31-residue window, localisation probability >= 0.75, 1 % FDR. Tumours grown in mice: a peptide identical in mouse and human can come from mouse stroma (flag xenograft_only).
